sources.title: Darwin Skill 2.0 SKILL.md
facts: Raw SKILL.md is 31,456 bytes and 519 lines at the pinned commit.
9 dimensions with weights 7, 12, 12, 6, 18, 4, 12, 23, 6; weights sum to 100.
Score formula is sum(dimension score x weight) / 10, with dimension scores from 1 to 10.
Absolute score is triage-only; keep/revert uses paired same-judge comparison with odd N (default 3, close call 5) and majority better vs worse.
Human checkpoints are mandatory; test prompts are 2-3 per skill; a dry_run ratio above 30% triggers the source's evaluation-invalid warning.
Revert uses git revert, not git reset --hard; optimized SKILL.md must not exceed 150% of original size.
results.tsv columns include timestamp, commit, skill, old_score, new_score, status, dimension, note, eval_mode.
Runtime-neutrality scan is a gate.
inferences: The rubric arithmetic and paired-majority rule are deterministic and can be unit-tested without a model.
The model-based dimension scoring is not reproducible without an independent judge and test prompts.
author_claims: SkillLens accuracy 46.4% to 73.8%; +46.5 mean delta; HL-1 to HL-4 score gains; 5-judge consensus claims were not independently replicated.
The author states absolute LLM-judge scores have about +/-8 noise, which supports paired comparison but is itself an author claim.
